constraints: This command cannot be used with an external connection opened directly or via ODBC.
The export files are placed in a folder named "SQLExport" created inside folderPath; if an "SQLExport" folder already exists there, it is replaced without any warning.
If folderPath is an empty string, a standard folder-selection dialog box is displayed (defaulting to the current user's Documents folder).
The generated Export.sql file(s) can be fed directly into SQL EXECUTE SCRIPT to import the data into another 4D database.
